item_short_desc: Rothco’s Expandable Spring Baton compacts down to just 9 inches for easy mounting on your duty belt.
description: Rothco’s Expandable Spring Baton compacts down to just 9 inches for easy mounting on your duty belt. The police baton features a friction lock that opens with swift wrist action to extend to 23 inches long. The public safety baton also provides an easy-to-grip rubber handle with a wrist strap.
